Location is used only for official work purposes and is never shared with third parties. Allow background location? While your shift is active, ONAQT records your location in the background, even when the app is closed or not in use, to build your My Day route and calculate travel distance for claims. It stops automatically when you end your day or sign out. You can pause it for a short break from the dashboard. Only you and your organisation\'s managers can see it; it is never used for advertising. Location Permission Needed ONAQT uses your location when you tap Start Work or End Work to:\n\n• Verify that you have reached the assigned work site\n• Record accurate work start and end times\n• Calculate travel distance for reimbursement claims\n\nLocation data is used only for official work purposes and is not shared with third parties. Share Current Location ONAQT uses your current location, when you choose to share it, to:\n\n• Show your current coordinates and address\n• Help your organization save your official office location\n• Allow attendance marking within 500 meters of the office\n\nLocation data is used only for official work purposes and is not shared with third parties.
